title: Demurrage and Detention Free Time: Slab Positions of Billed Demurrage Days
content:
A billed demurrage day on a Demurrage and Detention Free Time record is priced by slab, and the slab is fixed by the day's place in the demurrage slab count.

## Where the count begins

- **Separate clocks, either direction:** the first demurrage day billed is position 1.
- **Merged clock, import:** the count starts with the first chargeable day of the merged clock, so the first demurrage day billed is position 1.
- **Merged clock, export:** the demurrage days are the later stretch of a single run of chargeable days whose earlier stretch is billed as detention. Their count is therefore taken from the record itself: it carries on from the chargeable days entered on the detention line booked on the record, so the first demurrage day billed sits one position beyond those detention days. A record that carries no detention line adds no detention days to the count, and its first demurrage day is position 1.

Each further demurrage day occupies the following position.

## Bands

| Position of the day | Slab |
|---|---|
| up to the first slab length | 1 |
| above that, up to the first two slab lengths added together | 2 |
| above that, up to the three slab lengths added together | 3 |
| above the three slab lengths added together | 4 |

## Illustrations (hypothetical slab lengths of 4, 4 and 8)

| Record | Demurrage days billed | Positions | Split by slab |
|---|---|---|---|
| separate export | 6 | 1 to 6 | 4 in slab 1, 2 in slab 2 |
| merged import | 7 | 1 to 7 | 4 in slab 1, 3 in slab 2 |
| merged export, detention line showing 6 chargeable days | 5 | 7 to 11 | 2 in slab 2, 3 in slab 3 |
| merged export, record carrying no detention line | 5 | 1 to 5 | 4 in slab 1, 1 in slab 2 |

In the third row the same five demurrage days land two slabs higher than in the fourth, which is why the detention days entered on the record decide the demurrage figure of a merged export record.
